full_script: Money was never designed to sit in one place. That is why it is called currency. Currency must be current. If water ceases to flow, it becomes a breeding ground for mosquitoes. If your capital ceases to circulate, it becomes emotional baggage. You boast that you have kept two million naira under your mattress for ten years. Meanwhile, inflation has downgraded your life savings to the price of two bags of rice. Those who run after paper money cannot run a sustainable enterprise. The wealthy understand that cash is merely an instrument to acquire perpetual leverage. Keep your capital moving, upgrade your knowledge constantly, and stop worshipping paper that loses value while you are asleep.
